text: Research done, nothing built (research/kalshi_plus_novig_2026-10-17.md). Short version: trading both adds a second place to take the same edge, modest volume (Kalshi lists far fewer sports markets) and Kalshi charges a taker fee (~1.75c at 50c) while Novig pregame is fee-free, so only resting/maker orders there would make sense; it needs a Kalshi trading key (your call). Pure arbitrage is not impossible but not 'free money': both books track Pinnacle with 1-3c spreads so combined cost is usually 1.02-1.06, gaps open for seconds after news, and the rules differ (Novig voids on pushes, Kalshi strikes/ties/settlement differ) so a hedge can leak. I have not measured how often gaps occur. I suggest a free read-only logger on the engine for 3-5 days (no orders) to count real net gaps, then decide. Say 'do the logger' and I'll build it.
